```yaml
name: Promote RC to Stable

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rc_tag:
        description: 'RC Tag to promote (e.g., v3.0.0-rc5)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: write

jobs:
  validate:
    name: Validate RC Tag
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      commit_sha: ${{ steps.get_sha.outputs.sha }}
      stable_tag: ${{ steps.set_vars.outputs.stable_tag }}
      rc_tag: ${{ inputs.rc_tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set variables
        id: set_vars
        run: |
          RC_TAG="${{ inputs.rc_tag }}"
          # Remove 'v' prefix if present, remove '-rcN' suffix to get stable version
          VERSION="${RC_TAG#v}"
          STABLE_VERSION="${VERSION%%-rc*}"
          STABLE_TAG="v${STABLE_VERSION}"
          echo "stable_tag=${STABLE_TAG}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "rc_tag=${RC_TAG}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Get Commit SHA for RC Tag
        id: get_sha
        run: |
          SHA=$(git rev-list -n 1 ${{ inputs.rc_tag }})
          echo "sha=${SHA}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Validate RC Tag Exists
        run: |
          if ! git rev-parse ${{ inputs.rc_tag }} >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "::error::RC tag ${{ inputs.rc_tag }} does not exist in the repository."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate Stable Tag Does Not Exist
        run: |
          if git rev-parse ${{ steps.set_vars.outputs.stable_tag }} >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "::error::Stable tag ${{ steps.set_vars.outputs.stable_tag }} already exists. Cannot promote."
            exit 1
          fi

  promote:
    name: Promote to Stable
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: release
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Create Stable Git Tag
        env:
          STABLE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.commit_sha }}
        run: |
          git tag "$STABLE_TAG" "$COMMIT_SHA"
          git push origin "$STABLE_TAG"

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Retag Docker Images (beyla)
        env:
          RC_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}
          STABLE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
        run: |
          docker buildx imagetools create \
            --tag grafana/beyla:"${STABLE_TAG}" \
            grafana/beyla:"${RC_TAG}"

      - name: Retag Docker Images (beyla-k8s-cache)
        env:
          RC_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}
          STABLE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
        run: |
          docker buildx imagetools create \
            --tag grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:"${STABLE_TAG}" \
            grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:"${RC_TAG}"

      - name: Download RC Release Assets
        id: download_assets
        uses: robinraju/release-downloader@v1.11
        with:
          repository: "grafana/beyla"
          tag: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}
          fileName: "*"
          out-file-path: "rc_assets"
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create Stable GitHub Release
        id: create_release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          name: "Beyla ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          body: |
            ## Beyla ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
            
            This is the stable release of Beyla, promoted from ${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}.
            
            ### Changes
            See the [Release Notes](${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/releases/tag/${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}) for details on changes in this version.
            
            ### Assets
            The following assets have been copied from the RC release:
            - Beyla binaries for various platforms
            - Checksums and signatures
            
            ### Manual Follow-up
            - [ ] Update Helm chart to point to stable Docker tags
            - [ ] Update technical documentation links if necessary
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          files: rc_assets/*
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Post Workflow Summary
        run: |
          echo "## Promotion Complete" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **RC Tag:** ${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Stable Tag:** ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Commit SHA:** ${{ needs.validate.outputs.commit_sha }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "### Actions Taken" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Created git tag ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Retagged Docker images:" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "  - \`grafana/beyla:${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "  - \`grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}\`" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Created GitHub Release with copied assets" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "### Manual Follow-up Required" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- [ ] Update Helm chart to use stable tags" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- [ ] Verify technical documentation references" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
```
